div.head: Initiating Fieldwork
div.p: January 2022 – May 2022: PhD students Antonella Torzullo, Gunda Kinzl, Terlan Djavadova, Claudia Laaber and post-doc. Dr. Ana Iriarte Díez begin their first fieldwork in the framework of the project. They conduct linguistic investigations in Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Morocco and Lebanon. More information on their experiences can be found in the ‘blog’ section of our website.
